prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1170; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, consistent in nature and severity with the mechanism of injury reported. Initial examination documented cervical and lumbar paraspinal tenderness, restricted range of motion, and muscle guarding. Imaging and clinical findings clearly confirm soft tissue strain of the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known to this provider. Care was delivered over 27 visits, comprising manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. The course of treatment ran somewhat longer than typical for uncomplicated strain injuries, reflecting a gradual but steady response to conservative care. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At discharge, the patient demonstrated improved range of motion and reduced pain, with residual stiffness noted on forward flexion. Continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up were recommended.
